name: print-social-desktop-folders-social-media-portfolio-title-slide
title: Cream title slide with huge heavy 'social media', cursor and three blue folders
whatItIs: A cream slide with a giant chocolate heavy sans 'social media', a pixel-outlined cursor at its end, a small subline, and three blue folders labelled 'social media', 'instagram' and 'posts' scattered around.
whatItMeans: Simple and friendly; folders turn a title into a computer desktop.
techniques: Set one huge heavy word as the title.
Add a cursor as a call to click.
Use only cream, brown and blue.

vocabulary.definition: Icons placed randomly like a desktop.
A pointer used as an ornament.
A slide introducing a new section.
